interfaces.exchange: framed JSON/CBOR records over stdio with node ids, source timestamps and status codes retained raw
interfaces.name: OPC UA client (read-only subscriptions)
interfaces.why_native: Certified and vendor-supported stacks are C/C++; security policies (X.509, SignAndEncrypt) and subscription timing are implemented there

interfaces.exchange: pcapng captures with sha256; decoded PDO snapshots with working counters and TAP timestamps retained
identity: TAP device model and firmware version
libraries: TAP or probe device driver (vendor C)
interfaces.name: EtherCAT passive monitoring (network TAP capture)
interfaces.why_native: Line-rate capture with hardware timestamps needs kernel capture drivers and C dissectors; a Python loop cannot keep up with cyclic frames at microsecond spacing

interfaces.exchange: raw frame bytes with sha256, chunk timestamps and camera feature snapshot (GenICam XML digest)
interfaces.name: Vendor camera SDKs (GenICam GenTL)
interfaces.why_native: Proprietary drivers, zero-copy buffers and hardware triggers are exposed only through C/C++ ABIs

interfaces.exchange: PLY/PCD files with sha256 in and out; parameters in a retained request
interfaces.name: Point cloud processing (PCL / Open3D)
interfaces.why_native: Registration, KD-tree and surface reconstruction kernels are C++ with nondeterministic threading unless pinned; bindings would put unaudited native state in the evidence process

interfaces.exchange: STEP/BREP files with sha256; exported meshes and measurements as retained records
interfaces.name: CAD kernel (OpenCASCADE)
interfaces.why_native: B-rep, STEP/IGES translation and tolerance handling live in the C++ kernel
